resources.string: Understand the AI world in 3 minutes a day
AI reads the day\'s news for you
8 quality sources are fetched ahead of time by the data pipeline with Chinese digests — open and read, no waiting
Content updates in batches, not real-time
Data refreshes several times a day on a schedule; a pull-to-refresh saying \"You\'re up to date\" means this batch has nothing new
A reader that stays out of your way
The built-in reader supports reader mode, AI page translation and resume reading; tap the star while reading to save for later
Tap the active tab again to scroll to top and refresh; drag the voice-brief pill to tuck it away; long-press to reorder sources on the Sources page
